structural assets.functionality: Stores accumulated external and internal exception indications.

structural assets.reason: Combines buffered exception indications into a trap request. It controls whether exception handling begins.
structural assets.functionality: Combines buffered exception indications into a trap request.
structural assets.justification: It controls whether exception handling begins.

structural assets.label: primary
structural assets.reason: Carries coprocessor completion status into the controller. It is the input boundary status that determines completion of the external operation.
structural assets.functionality: Carries coprocessor completion status into the controller.
structural assets.justification: It is the input boundary status that determines completion of the external operation.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: Enables write-back when coprocessor completion is accepted. The completion status decides its assignment and can cause premature result commitment.
structural assets.functionality: Enables write-back when coprocessor completion is accepted.
structural assets.justification: The completion status decides its assignment and can cause premature result commitment.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: Leaves EX_ALU_WAIT when completion is asserted. The completion input directly controls the state transition and therefore can stall or advance execution.
structural assets.functionality: Leaves EX_ALU_WAIT when completion is asserted.
structural assets.justification: The completion input directly controls the state transition and therefore can stall or advance execution.

structural assets.label: primary
structural assets.reason: Carries load-store completion status into the controller. It is the input boundary status that determines whether the external memory operation has completed.
structural assets.functionality: Carries load-store completion status into the controller.
structural assets.justification: It is the input boundary status that determines whether the external memory operation has completed.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: Enables or suppresses write-back after a memory response. The wait status decides its assignment and can commit or block the response.
structural assets.functionality: Enables or suppresses write-back after a memory response.
structural assets.justification: The wait status decides its assignment and can commit or block the response.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: Leaves EX_MEM_RSP when the LSU reports completion or an error. The wait input directly controls the state transition and can stall or advance the controller.

structural assets.justification: The wait input directly controls the state transition and can stall or advance the controller.

structural assets.label: primary
structural assets.reason: Stores the generated CPU sleep state. It is the clocked state that directly represents the conceptual sleep condition.

structural assets.justification: It is the clocked state that directly represents the conceptual sleep condition.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: Decides whether a sleeping frontend permits sleep_mode to assert. It controls the assignment of the primary sleep state.
structural assets.functionality: Decides whether a sleeping frontend permits sleep_mode to assert.
structural assets.justification: It controls the assignment of the primary sleep state.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: Prevents or clears sleep_mode when a wakeup condition is present. It gates the sleep-state assignment and can block entry into the state.
structural assets.functionality: Prevents or clears sleep_mode when a wakeup condition is present.
structural assets.justification: It gates the sleep-state assignment and can block entry into the state.

structural assets.label: primary
structural assets.reason: Stores the CPU sleep state before it is reported. It is the internal register holding the conceptual sleep state.
structural assets.functionality: Stores the CPU sleep state before it is reported.
structural assets.justification: It is the internal register holding the conceptual sleep state.

structural assets.label: primary
structural assets.reason: Carries the CPU sleep indication across the unit boundary. ctrl_o.cpu_sleep is the boundary output for this state.
structural assets.functionality: Carries the CPU sleep indication across the unit boundary.
structural assets.justification: ctrl_o.cpu_sleep is the boundary output for this state.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: Controls sleep-state entry while the frontend is halted. It decides the assignment of sleep_mode.
structural assets.functionality: Controls sleep-state entry while the frontend is halted.
structural assets.justification: It decides the assignment of sleep_mode.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: Gates sleep entry when an interrupt or debug wakeup exists. It can block the primary sleep state from becoming available.
structural assets.functionality: Gates sleep entry when an interrupt or debug wakeup exists.
structural assets.justification: It can block the primary sleep state from becoming available.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: Paces updates of the sleep-state register. Blocking its clock can stall the sleep-state update.
structural assets.functionality: Paces updates of the sleep-state register.
structural assets.justification: Blocking its clock can stall the sleep-state update.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: Clears the sleep-state register. Its reset path can clear or prevent retention of the sleep state.
structural assets.functionality: Clears the sleep-state register.
structural assets.justification: Its reset path can clear or prevent retention of the sleep state.

structural assets.label: secondary
structural assets.reason: Supplies the register source operand used in CSR write-data formation. It influences the computed CSR write operand but is multiplexed with instruction-derived data, so it is not the sole primary value.
structural assets.functionality: Supplies the register source operand used in CSR write-data formation.

structural assets.justification: It is an intermediate operand path to the computed CSR write data.

structural assets.functionality: Computes the CSR write-data value from the selected operand and current CSR data.
structural assets.justification: It is the internal wire holding the final operand-derived CSR update value.

structural assets.label: secondary

structural assets.functionality: Provides the current CSR value combined with the selected operand.

structural assets.justification: The control record is the boundary crossing that exposes and delivers the conceptual operand data.

structural assets.justification: It carries and retains the request until interrupt qualification.
